Name: head_final_cohesion
Title: Constrained Clustering: Keep ja-ko-mn Together for Mongolian Transfer
Experiment: Modify cluster_embedding() so ja, ko, mn must share one cluster (hard or soft constraint) before/during agglomerative clustering. Cap500 floor: embedding groups {ja,ko,mn} but still loses to matched_random (0.228). Add cohesion constraint. Success: embedding_clustering mongolian_f1 > 0.228.

Name: script_aware_mn_ru_penalty
Title: Script-Aware Typology Distance: Penalize Mongolian-Russian Cyrillic Confusion
Experiment: Extend _hybrid_lang_distance_matrix() with an extra penalty when pairing mn with ru/en (script-similarity trap) unless typology strongly agrees. Goal: prevent mn from training only with {ko,mn} or {mn,ru,en} when ja typology neighbors are better. Tune penalty weight. Compare embedding vs matched_random mn F1.

Name: min_budget_linguistic_fallback
Title: Minimum-Train-Budget Fallback to Linguistic Prior
Experiment: Implement post_cluster_train_langs() (EVOLVE-BLOCK): if count_train_samples(train_langs) < threshold OR unique mn exposure too low, fallback train langs to HEAD_FINAL set {ja,ko,mn}. Prevents pathological small clusters like run_1 N=600. Evaluate on full WikiAnn default settings.

Name: mn_oversample_transfer
Title: Mongolian Oversampling Within Selected Transfer Languages
Experiment: Implement augment_train_raw(): after language selection, oversample mn sentences (e.g. 3x) within the training pool before NER fine-tune. WikiAnn mn train is only ~100 unique sentences; increase mn exposure without changing cluster logic. Keep five conditions; only changes embedding/linguistic train data composition.

Name: typology_weighted_mixture
Title: Soft Typology-Weighted Training Mixture Instead of Hard Cluster Cut
Experiment: Replace hard langs_in_cluster() selection with typology-based language weights (HEAD_FINAL languages up-weighted for mn target). Sample or weight training sentences proportional to typology similarity to mn. Target: beat matched_random 0.228.

Name: k2_silhouette_head_final
Title: Silhouette k Selection with k>=2 and HEAD_FINAL Merger
Experiment: Change _select_k_by_silhouette() to never split {ja,ko,mn} across clusters: either fix k=2 with typology prior merge, or search k in {2,3} only among partitions where ja,ko,mn are co-located. Addresses run_2 failure mode without abandoning data-driven k.
